create_sharded_tensor_from_local_shards: create a ShardedTensor from a list of local shards and global size using SPMD initialization
gather_sharded_tensor_to_full: gather all shards of a ShardedTensor into a full dense tensor on a destination rank
reshard_sharded_tensor: reshard a ShardedTensor to a new ChunkShardingSpec with different sharding dimension or placements
retrieve_local_shard_tensor: retrieve the local shard tensor from a ShardedTensor with a single local shard
move_sharded_tensor_to_device: move all local shards of a ShardedTensor to CPU or CUDA memory
